# 10 Scrapped Recipes (Forbidden Knowledge II)

## Post 6481 by Dragunovi (Turtle WoW Team) [STAFF] — 2020-06-21T11:14:00Z
<!-- url: https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=6481#p6481 | page 1 | era: pre-1.18.1 -->

**Update: Learned that most of these recipes don't actually exist in-game so i remade them using the Editor, now they're ready to use!** You can find the required materials from the old broken versions of the recipes. (Feeling too lazy to write them.)
I did some digging around a few databases and caught these ripe for using! Check them out!

[Alchemist's Stone](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=13517/recipe-alchemists-stone) (An actual useful trinket for alchemists to use!)(Already working, remake not needed.)  (Maybe bought from [Alchemist Pestlezugg](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=5594/alchemist-pestlezugg) or as a boss drop from **Molten Core.**)

[Recipe: Greater Holy Protection Potion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Greater Holy Protection Potion](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (Maybe bought from [Algernon](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=4610/algernon), the Undercity Alchemy supplies vendor.)([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=13500/recipe-greater-holy-protection-potion))

[Plans: Inlaid Thorium Hammer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Inlaid Thorium Hammer](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (Just a good 2 handed heavy hammer, good as a stat stick for **Bear Druids**)(Could be bought from [Krinkle Goodsteel](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=5411/krinkle-goodsteel), the blacksmithing vendor in **Gatgetzan**) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=12818/plans-inlaid-thorium-hammer))

[Pattern: Boots of Darkness](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Boots of Darkness](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (The lost brother of **Hands of Darkness**.)(Bought from [Zixil](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=3537/zixil), a goblin merchant that goes between **Tarren Mill** and **Southshore**.)([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7093/pattern-boots-of-darkness))

[Pattern: Green Woolen Robe](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Green Woolen Robe](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) (Bought from [Ranik](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=3499/ranik) in Ratchet.) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=6273/pattern-green-woolen-robe))

 **The Stormcloth Set**

[Pattern: Stormcloth Shoulders](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Stormcloth Shoulders](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=10322/pattern-stormcloth-shoulders))

[Pattern: Stormcloth Vest](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Stormcloth Vest](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=10313/pattern-stormcloth-vest))

[Pattern: Stormcloth Gloves](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Stormcloth Gloves](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=10304/pattern-stormcloth-gloves))

[Pattern: Stormcloth Headband](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Stormcloth Headband](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=10319/pattern-stormcloth-headband))

[Pattern: Stormcloth Pants](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) teaches how to make [Stormcloth Pants](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) ([Broken Version](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=10303/pattern-stormcloth-pants))

Its main ingredient is **Globe of Water**, a normally almost useless material finding good use.
The set mostly has Nature spellpower as its main bonus with the Tunic having Healing Power and the Shoulders having Shadow Spellpower (Corruption?). See below how to get the patterns for the set.

The quests to get the **Stormcloth Set** start at the **Circle of Inner Binding**, given by [Shikrin Stormcaller <Wandering Shaman>](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) .The first quest he gives you is [Stormcloth Armor](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) which explains the armor set and asks for some mageweave to prove your willing to learn how to sew the armor set. After this quest is completed he gives you 5 quests, one for each recipe.

[Stormcloth Shoulders](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) asks for 10 [Bolts of Mageweave](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=4339/bolt-of-mageweave) for the shoulder pattern, but it got splashed with demon blood in a recent conflict and got corrupted! **(Increases your shadow spellpower instead!)**

[Stormcloth Vest](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) wants you to bring 20 [Bottles of Enchanted Water](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=4791/enchanted-water) and 2 [Bottles of Elemental Water](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7070/elemental-water) to make remedies for his future wounds. He rewards you with the vest pattern when you bring them. **(Increases Healing Power!)**

[Stormcloth Gloves](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!) wants you to bring 10 [Solid Stones](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7912/solid-stone) and 2 [Rocks of Elemental Earth](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7067/elemental-earth) for his earth magic. He rewards you with the gloves pattern when you bring them **(Increases Spellpower and Healing Power!)**

[Stormcloth Headband](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) sends you to collect 10 [Thundering Charms](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=4480/thundering-charm) from [Thundering Exiles](https://classic.wowhead.com/npc=2762/thundering-exile) in the **Circle of Outer Binding**, northeast of the **Circle of Inner Binding**. He rewards you with the headband pattern when you bring them.

[Stormcloth Pants](https://dev.turtlecraft.gg/#!~) wants you to bring 5 [Clouds of Elemental Air](https://classic.wowhead.com/item=7069/elemental-air) as reagents his Lightning Storm spell. (Wink wink!) He rewards you with the pants pattern when you bring them.

> ... these are classic items, not "scraped vanilla items".
>
>  and Turtle WoW is a vanilla server, not a clone of blizz's classic...

There is no such thing as a classic item. These items were added into the database of the vanilla game (which is the exact same as the database of classic, kinda the whole point) but without a way to obtain them so they are considered scrapped content. If you looked at the items in the classic database you would see that they are unobtainable there as well, so addung them here... would actually make it **more different** than Classic Wow, not a clone of it.
